Subject: Kickoff: Vectech MAP & evaluation onboarding

Thanks Elena & Samir — excited to get started.

Per our discovery, Redwood will run a focused evaluation MAP to validate latency, cost, and quality for your customer-facing summarization pipeline with a target decision point the week of Oct 19. The goal of this kickoff thread is to align owners, define the initial technical agenda, and surface any early blockers.

High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm primary technical owner for integration and certified test data delivery.
- Confirm any compliance constraints (PII minimization, no-export zones).
- Share a preferred 60-min slot for an engineering kickoff this week.

Proposed owners (please edit):
- Redwood SE: Aditya Rao — technical lead for integration and infra pairing (cc'ed)
- Redwood ML: Mina Haddad — evaluation metrics, model selection, and regression checks (cc'ed)
- Vectech Integration Lead: Samir Patel — implementation and test harness owner
- Vectech Data/Prod Lead: Elena Vargas — systems and security approver

Suggested initial agenda (60 min):
1) Introductions + roles and success criteria (10m)
2) Data scope & access method (S3 / secure upload) (10m)
3) Evaluation plan overview (metrics, test sets, QA criteria) (15m)
4) Integration checklist & infra (auth, endpoints, rate/batching) (15m)
5) Next steps & timeline to decision (10m)

I've attached a first-pass MAP workbook and a short data sample checklist for your security team to review. If anything here looks off, edit the owners and I will update the MAP.

Available windows for the engineering kickoff (PDT): Wed 10/6 2–4pm, Thu 10/7 9–11am, Fri 10/8 11–2pm.

Thanks — Sofia

Hi Elena, Samir — nice to meet you virtually. I'll own the integration pairing and the runtime/infra checklist. A few practical items I want to surface ahead of the call so we can hit the ground running: 

1) Auth & endpoints
   - We support API key, OAuth, and short-lived signed credentials for private deployments. For S3 ingestion of test sets, short-lived STS creds are fine.
2) Test data shape & size
   - For representative evaluation, we recommend 1,000–2,500 labeled examples for the first quality pass (subset with human-verified labels). If you are constrained, we can start with 200 samples for a quick smoke.
3) Sandboxing & traffic routing
   - If you want production-like latency, let us know expected seq lengths and qps. We typically mirror your expected 95th percentile request size and do KV-prefix caching for repeated prompts.
4) Canary plan and rollback
   - We'll provide a canary variant with conservative quantization for an initial sanity run, then expand to higher-performance variants if quality meets threshold.

Action items before the call (Aditya):
- Share a short runbook (auth + test endpoints) — attached link in the MAP workbook.
- Prepare a lightweight load profile template for you to fill.

Agenda tweak suggestion: please add 5 min at the end for decision criteria and acceptance gates.

I can do Wed 10/6 2:30–3:30pm PDT (fits Sofia's window) — happy to pair and do live integration checks.

— Aditya

Quick note from the ML side with the evaluation plan skeleton we'll walk through: 

Primary objectives:
- Meet production latency (95p) and maintain precision/recall targets for entity-summary extraction.
- Measure hallucination rate under prompts typical of your UI flows.

Evaluation components:
- Test sets: 2,000 labeled examples ideal; 250–500 for an initial regression smoke.
- Metrics: exact match / F1 for extraction, ROUGE-L for summaries, and an aggregated utility score weighted by your business-importance mapping (we'll collect weights during the call).
- Regression gating: no more than 5% drop in utility score vs baseline for canary acceptance.
- Quality monitoring: daily evaluation runs during the MAP with runbook to flag regressions and trigger rollback.

Model & infra notes:
- We'll test two families: a 7B param quantized variant (low-cost baseline) and a 13B higher-capacity variant for quality comparison.
- Request: please provision an S3 location or secure upload we can access for evaluation data; provide a short-lived role/creds and an expected TTL for artifacts.

I'll bring a simple notebook to show evaluation code and metric calculations in the kickoff.

Thanks — Mina
